requests.name: pfxL-1
requests.text: This text outlines the terms for conveying verbatim and modified copies of a program, requiring that copyright notices and license terms be kept intact and that any modifications be prominently noted. It specifies that object code may be conveyed only if the corresponding source code

requests.name: pfxL-2
requests.text: This text outlines the terms for conveying verbatim and modified copies of a program, requiring that copyright notices and license terms be kept intact and that any modifications be prominently noted. It specifies that object code may be conveyed only if the corresponding source code

requests.name: pfxL-3
requests.text: This text outlines the terms for conveying (distributing) verbatim and modified copies of a licensed work, requiring that all copies retain copyright notices, license terms, and warranty disclaimers. It specifies that modified versions must be prominently marked

requests.name: pfxL-4
requests.text: Section 6 covers conveying the work in non-source (object code) forms. It requires that the machine-readable Corresponding Source be conveyed along with the object code, in one of several specified ways.

requests.name: pfxL-5
requests.text: The text defines it as "any express agreement or commitment, however denominated, not to enforce a patent (such as an express permission to practice a patent or covenant not to sue for patent infringement)."
